title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.12.0 adds three separate cavity notebooks while preserving existing lesson cells and outputs: seven-Reynolds-number Ghia validation, a three-seed CPU centreline-surrogate study of optimizer, depth and weighting, and an author-supplied D/W=5 CFD/PINN regional assessment at four Reynolds numbers. Four existing lecture PDFs gain matching reading sections. The neural study reports both improvements over Adam and losses to linear interpolation; it is not a full-field or PDE benchmark. The deep-cavity bundle reproduces 128 retained regional values, not a new independent-seed training study. The four highest-Re square-cavity full fields remain unqualified. The broader course covers continuum and rarefied CFD, reduced-order models, PINNs, neural operators and attention-based learning. Case-specific data provenance and scientific limitations are documented in the repository.
